{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = "/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv"
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Convert 'revenue' from string to float, handling thousands separators
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
non_qa_df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Define the target group: new customers reached by paid search
target_group = non_qa_df[(non_qa_df['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (non_qa_df['channel'] == 'paid_search')]

# Compute the conversion rate: fraction of converted orders in this group
num_converted = target_group['converted'].sum()
total_in_group = len(target_group)
conversion_rate = num_converted / total_in_group

# Print the result
print(f"Number of orders in target group (after excluding QA): {total_in_group}")
print(f"Number of converted orders: {num_converted}")
print(f"Conversion rate: {conversion_rate}")

# Return the conversion rate as a float
conversion_rate"}
